briefdescription.para: Creates and checks the signed tokens used to authenticate clients. (Originally: "Issues and validates the HS256 JWTs that authenticate clients.").

detaileddescription.para: This header declares TokenManager. It builds a JWT (a signed, self-contained credential) from the client's identity, and checks tokens that clients send back. A coroutine variant performs the checks without blocking web request threads.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: After a successful login, the client receives one of these tokens and sends it with later requests. TokenManager is what turns that string back into a trusted identity. Without it, the server could not recognize returning users.

JWT (JSON Web Token): https://jwt.io/introduction
HMAC / HS256 signing: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HMAC
